case.summary: Case HHG-002 was opened after real-time monitoring flagged online transaction 3478782 for $292.36 on 2016-11-22 17:27:07 for card C11891-K1 (customer C11891), which deviated significantly from the card's 35-transaction baseline average of $44.66 (z=9.7). A supervised model estimated a calibrated fraud probability of 0.92 matching a card-not-present fraud pattern. When contacted, customer C11891 confirmed they still held the card and did not authorize the transaction. The final verdict is fraud, resulting in the card being blocked and the case recorded without a SAR filing as exposure is below $1,000.
